title: TUI detail pane shows every item and slice field
lead: The detail pane shows an item's lead, cites, provenance, pass, flags, group, short title, attempts and note kind/trust, and lets the owner edit the lead, pass, flags and short title, through the same ops the CLI uses.
findings_note: owner request, session 2026-10-14: bring the TUI up to date with recent CLI features
boundary: **Not in this slice:** sibling claims (s277), dependency and history panes (s278), catalog editing (s281). No new ops: every edit goes through an existing `ops` function.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: `panel()` (`src/slicer/tui.py:315`) renders the heading, status, claim, the eight `FIELD_SPEC` fields (`src/slicer/tui.py:106`), score, boundary, sections and notes. It leaves out the slice lead (s252 made it editable from the CLI), `cites` (catalog), `discovered_from`, `pass`, `flags`, `group`, `short_title` and `attempts`, and notes show no kind, trust or verification. A reader of the TUI therefore sees less than `slicer show ID`, and has to drop to the CLI to edit a lead, a pass or flags.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/tui.py`: `FIELD_SPEC` (line 106) and `_field_current` (line 118) gain `short title`, `pass` and `flags` (comma list, through `set_fields` `flags=`). `entries()` (line 293) gains a `lead` entry before the boundary. `panel()` (line 315) shows lead paragraphs, `discovered from`, `group`, `attempts`, and a `cites` line that resolves each id to `C01 goal: title` as the slice header does. Each note line carries its kind and trust. `apply_edit_result()` (line 469) routes `lead` to `ops.edit_lead` (`src/slicer/ops.py:1922`), splitting paragraphs on blank lines as `edit --lead` does.
- `docs/tui.md` "Editing", `CHANGELOG.md` `[Unreleased]`.
- `tests/test_tui.py`.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `test_Panel_SliceWithLead_ShowsLeadBeforeBoundary`
- `test_Panel_ItemWithCites_ResolvesKindAndTitle`, retired record marked `(retired)`
- `test_Panel_ShowsPassFlagsGroupAttemptsDiscoveredFrom`
- `test_Panel_TypedNote_ShowsKindAndTrust`
- `test_ApplyEdit_Lead_SplitsParagraphsLikeEditLead`; empty body clears the lead
- `test_ApplyEdit_Flags_CommaListReplacesFlags`; `test_ApplyEdit_Pass_SetsPass`; `test_ApplyEdit_ShortTitle_Sets`
- `test_Entries_IndexesStayAlignedWithPanel`: every `PanelLine.entry` maps to the `entries()` item of the same index, with and without a slice.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the tests and watch them go red.
2. Extend `FIELD_SPEC`, `entries()` and `panel()`, keeping the entry indexes in step.
3. Route the lead edit to `ops.edit_lead`.
4. Update `docs/tui.md` and the CHANGELOG.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `python3 tests/affected.py --run`, then the full suite.
- `slicer check` and `git diff --check` pass.
- By hand: `slicer tui` on this repo, select s273, and see its lead, pass and score.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Worktree `.worktrees/s276`, branch `feature/s276-tui-all-fields`. Commit only on the branch. Merging and pushing wait for the owner.
